motion.name: shell-dimensions
motion.value: Exact critical damping; independent width and height; opening omega 32/s; closing omega 38/s
motion.purpose: Retain position and velocity through retargets; animate the silhouette and Win32 input region within the fixed 600 × 370 logical-point backing viewport.

motion.name: shell-content-reveal
motion.value: smoothstep; compact progress 0.02–0.30; expanded 0.20–0.92; vertical offset 6pt → 0pt
motion.purpose: Lay out expanded text at final width under the animated mask; avoid reflow and late content swaps.

motion.name: lyric-line-change
motion.value: 240ms; native gamma multiplier 0.4 → 1.0; compact vertical offset 2pt → 0pt
motion.purpose: Emphasize each new line quietly; reduced motion applies the destination immediately.

motion.purpose: Cancel spring velocity and widget interpolation when the user requests reduced animation.

narrative.overview:
Sela is a calm companion at the top of the desktop. Its charcoal silhouette gives controls a quiet home; sage marks the available action and warm amber gives the current lyric a small glow. Pijar, the approved firefly mascot, brings warmth through one restrained identity asset.

The selected visual world is already established. The Operate direction extends the working native overlay with the approved Canvas music view while retaining focus, system status, and settings. This document records the implemented Rust/egui system; portable tokens use CSS pixels to represent egui logical points.
keyCharacteristics: A top-center charcoal silhouette with a compact resting state.
Sage actions, ivory content, and an amber current lyric.
DM Sans Regular and Semibold, with retained monospace timer and metric values.
Pijar as a small identity cue beside practical native controls.
Stable content geometry, continuous spring motion, and truthful media states.

rules.name: The Two Accents Rule
rules.body: Sage identifies action and active state; amber identifies the current lyric. Preserve those roles when adding media controls or lyric states.

rules.name: The Real Weight Rule
rules.body: Select the embedded semibold family for semibold content; keep the actual font choice explicit in native code.

rules.name: The Tonal Surface Rule
rules.body: Use raised charcoal and spacing to distinguish controls before adding any new elevation effect.

rules.name: The Continuous Motion Rule
rules.body: Preserve spring position and velocity when a target changes; never restart expansion from a preset endpoint.

dos: **Do** preserve Sela, Pijar, and the top-center charcoal silhouette as the selected identity.
**Do** use sage for primary actions and active state, and amber for the current lyric.
**Do** use the embedded DM Sans faces explicitly and retain monospace numerical anchors.
**Do** keep Canvas player and lyric columns stable, with lyrics left aligned.
**Do** retain keyboard focus, tooltips, reduced motion, and clear unavailable states.
**Do** distinguish real Windows data from explicitly labelled original demo content.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce archived mascot concepts as Sela identity assets.
**Don't** replace the authored note cover with artwork that was never fetched.
**Don't** restart interrupted springs or reflow text against every animated width.
**Don't** imply that plain lyrics are synced or that a missing lyric result stops playback.
**Don't** treat Linux previews as evidence that Windows integrations or input clipping have been exercised.
